name: Pseudhesperosuchus
isnote: A 2002 analysis (Clark and Sues) left it unresolved among sphenosuchians, neither closer to crocodylians nor to Sphenosuchus; the 2025 redescription (Leardi) is not checked here for a finer placement.
sum: Pseudhesperosuchus is a sphenosuchian crocodylomorph from the Late Triassic Los Colorados Formation of north-western Argentina.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted; the holotype is described as immature.
holotype: PVL 3830, a skull and lower jaws, most of the vertebral column, the shoulder girdle and parts of the arms and legs, from the Los Colorados Formation, Ischigualasto-Villa Unión Basin.
biology: The sources consulted describe the anatomy and classification but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Bonaparte 1969
